subject: Service details
text:
Hi,

Can you please share info about that service?
You mentioned it after the weekend.
The result was unexpectedly good.
I keep seeing related tickets at work.
The charge was lower than quoted.
I want details for a local friend.
Do you remember the shop name?
Is there a website?
Can they visit in the evening?
They help fix a drawer.
It is a small job.
If you have a number, I need it.
If not, tell me who helped you.
I want to point them the right way.
